title: pandas: missing values (isna, fillna, dropna)
source:
import pandas as pd

farm = pd.read_csv("farm.csv")
gaps = farm.isna().sum()
filled = farm.fillna({"yield_kg": 0})
complete = farm.dropna()
farm.dropna(subset=["rainfall_mm"], inplace=True)

steps.narration: farm now refers to a new DataFrame.
gaps now refers to a new Series.
filled now refers to a new DataFrame.
complete now refers to a new DataFrame.
